Description: To alter an existing 1,202 sq. ft. one-story single-family residence with an average height of 16’-5” by (1) converting a portion of the existing basement level to living space, and (2) constructing a two-story addition with an average height of 20’-9” at the rear of the building, within the non-conforming side yard setback to the east, resulting in a 2,408 sq. ft. two-story single-family residence. The project also includes demolition of the existing detached garage and installation of a new 9’ tall fence along the interior side property line to the west.
